name: DeFi Momentum Strategy
description: This momentum-based strategy focuses on trading a basket of high-volume DeFi tokens against USD or BTC pairs. It employs the Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) indicator on the 4-hour and daily timeframes to identify strong trending periods and generate trading signals. The strategy aims to capture medium-term price movements while managing risk through appropriate position sizing and stop-loss placement.
conditions: Enter long when the MACD line crosses above the signal line on the 4-hour timeframe, and the price is above the 50 EMA on the daily timeframe.
Enter short when the MACD line crosses below the signal line on the 4-hour timeframe, and the price is below the 50 EMA on the daily timeframe.
Exit long positions when the MACD line crosses below the signal line on the 4-hour timeframe, or the price closes below the 200 EMA on the daily timeframe.
Exit short positions when the MACD line crosses above the signal line on the 4-hour timeframe, or the price closes above the 200 EMA on the daily timeframe.

riskParameters.stopLossPercent: 2% below entry price for long positions, 2% above entry price for short positions
riskParameters.takeProfitPercent: 6% above entry price for long positions, 6% below entry price for short positions
riskParameters.trailingStopPercent: Activate trailing stop loss at 3% in the direction of the trade
